title: Pier planks
subject: Subject: the deck of a wooden pier seen from above, about 2.5 m across. Long weathered planks running straight across the picture from left to right, in staggered lengths with butt joints, warm mid-brown with grey-violet weathering, small dark nail holes and fine grain, thin dark gaps between the planks. At night, under cool blue moonlight.
use: The deck of the jetty's pier, the little jetties in the square, the cottage's footbridge; any boardwalk or pier.

title: Dark lake water
subject: Subject: the surface of a still, deep lake at night seen from straight above, about 4 m across. Very dark navy-black water with tiny soft ripples and small silver-blue glints of moonlight spread evenly. No reflections of anything, no lily pads, no bright streak.
use: The lake at the jetty and in the square, the cottage's pond; any still dark water.

title: Rounded stone wall
subject: Subject: the face of a low wall of rounded field stones, about 2 m across and 1 m high. Rounded, pillowy grey-blue stones of mixed sizes stacked in rough courses, some with a warm sandy top, dark gaps between them and a little moss. The picture's top edge is the wall's top row of stones and its bottom edge is the wall's foot. At night, under cool blue moonlight.
use: The quay wall and walls at the jetty, the garden walls in the square and round Io's garden; any low field or garden wall.

title: Striped awning cloth
subject: Subject: striped canvas awning cloth, seen straight on and flat, about 1.5 m across: broad stripes of faded deep red and cream, equal in width, running straight from top to bottom, slightly worn and soft, with a fine weave and very soft folds. At night, under cool blue moonlight.
use: The awnings of Quill's stall and Nettie's stall; any market stall awning.

title: Quill's stall
subject: Subject: a waterside stall, seen flat from the front. A wooden stall under a sloping awning of red and cream stripes with a scalloped front edge; under it a small table with a glowing lantern, jars and a tin; around it wooden crates, a big sack, barrels and a tall clay jar; on the right a wooden rack hung with fishing nets and coils of rope. The whole stall is in the picture.
use: Quill's shop stall on the quay.

title: Net rack
subject: Subject: a fisherman's net rack, seen flat from the front: two wooden posts and a cross-pole hung with brown fishing nets and looped ropes, a small wooden crate at the foot. The whole rack is in the picture.
use: Quill's net rack beside his stall.

title: Quay steps
subject: Subject: the head of a jetty seen flat from the lake: a low quay wall of rounded grey stones with a flight of wide stone steps in the middle, and a square stone pillar topped with a black iron lantern on each side of the steps. The whole width of the steps and both pillars are in the picture.
use: The front of the quay where the steps go down to the pier.

title: Rail fence
subject: Subject: a short wooden fence section, seen flat from the front: three upright posts with a top rail and two lower rails of dark weathered wood, iron nail heads. About 2 m long. The gaps are plain mid-grey.
use: The rail fence on the quay, behind Quill's stall.

title: Weeping willow
subject: Subject: one weeping willow tree, seen from the side, whole: a gnarled dark trunk and long hanging curtains of narrow leaves in olive, yellow-green and blue-green reaching almost to the ground. About 7 m tall. At night, under cool blue moonlight.

title: Reeds and cattails
subject: Subject: one clump of reeds and cattails, seen from the side, whole: tall thin blades in dark green and ochre, and several brown cattail heads on straight stems. About 1.5 m tall. At night, under cool blue moonlight.
use: The reeds at the jetty, round the cottage's pond and along the streams.

title: Lily pads
subject: Subject: one small cluster of five round lily pads floating flat, seen from exactly straight above: round leaves in mossy green, a notch cut into each, one with a small pale pink water-lily flower. About 1 m across. At night, under cool blue moonlight.
use: The lily pads on the lake, the square's lake, the cottage's pond and the Thornwood's stream.

title: Verge shrubs
subject: Subject: one low shrub, seen from the side, whole: dark green leaves dotted with small white and pale blue flowers. About 1 m wide and 0.6 m tall. At night, under cool blue moonlight.
use: The low flowering shrubs on the jetty's verges and in the woods' edge.
